about.Doctor Who theme music: TV theme by Ron Grainer and Delia Derbyshire. The Doctor Who theme music is the theme song of the science fiction programme Doctor Who.
about.Oramics: Drawn sound technique. Oramics is a drawn sound technique designed in 1957 by musician Daphne Oram.
about.Delia Derbyshire: English musician and composer of electronic music (1937–2001). Delia Ann Derbyshire (5 May 1937 – 3 July 2001) was an English musician and composer of electronic music.
about.BBC Radiophonic Workshop: Produced sound effects and programme scores from 1958-1998. The BBC Radiophonic Workshop was one of the sound effects units of the BBC, created in 1958 to produce incidental sounds and new music for radio and, later, television.
about.Daphne Oram: British composer and electronic musician (1925–2003). Daphne Blake Oram (31 December 1925 – 5 January 2003) was a British composer and electronic musician.
